summary: Fixed the off-by-one error in the bad() method. The while loop condition `i <= intArray.length` iterates one past the valid index range (i reaches 10, but valid indices are 0-9 for a length-10 array), causing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when accessing intArray[10]. Changed the condition to `i < intArray.length` so the loop writes to all valid indices 0 through 9 while staying within bounds.
